node_definition.done_when: Done when a test completes a review run without promoting it, then dispatches a second review of the same reviewed run naming the same record path. The second dispatch is admitted, and the first review's stored record is unchanged. A review still working keeps its claim and refuses the second. The negative control is the base revision, where the second dispatch is refused with scope-conflict. The test files importing the changed modules add no failure against the base revision, run on all_debug one arm at a time with at most -n 4 . Every log is under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in EXIT= . Ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Write paths: reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py , reckon/crew/runs.py and a new test file under tests/ .
